article.story: ALBANY, N.Y. -- — Victor Okojie had 22 points and 11 rebounds to power UMass Lowell to an 89-79 victory over Albany on Saturday night. Angel Montas added 21 points and six rebounds for the River Hawks (10-15, 5-5 America East Conference). Xavier Spencer shot 6 for 10 (3 for 5 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 18 points. Amir Lindsey finished with 23 points, seven assists and two steals for the Great Danes (8-17, 4-6). Okechukwu Okeke added 20 points, 11 rebounds and two blocks. Jaden Kempson finished with 18 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
